disclosures.title: using it
disclosures.body: Build it around Volatile Rebound and throw it above the group; the homing arcs it down and it explodes on the floor. Charged throws and explosions force Electricity procs, so it triggers Melee Influence without modding Electricity. Heavy-attack detonations self-stagger at close range. Charged throws keep their innate punch-through even with Volatile mods, which the wiki calls potentially a bug.
